main_text.l: Mulieres apud Aegyptios non utebatur calceis 447
Novum quod est, non semper malum 275

page.notes: The page number is not printed. The "N" at the lower right is the catchword "Nu", partly cut off by a flourish. "Aegyptios" and "Negociatio" have the initial letter set as a large decorative capital. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Doubtful readings: "astricta" (the word is set in a tall-s form, possibly "afflicta"), "Mulieris" (could be "Mulierum"), and the page numbers "24" and "331", which are slightly blurred.
